moduleData.description: Initial proximity analysis: is a detailed shadow study warranted? Buffers the building footprint by 4.3x height (CEQR longest-shadow factor) and checks for sensitive sites within the study area.

buffer_multiplier.description: Shadow radius multiplier (CEQR NYC default: 4.3). Override only if needed.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

building_height_ft.description: Building height in feet including all rooftop equipment

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction. NYC uses CEQR 4.3x buffer multiplier.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites dataset. If omitted, uses default NYC Parks dataset.

moduleData.name: shadow_tier1_screening

affected_sites.description: GeoJSON of sites within shadow radius

affected_sites_count.description: Number of sensitive sites within shadow radius

shadow_buffer.description: Buffer zone representing the longest-shadow study area

triggered.description: True if any sensitive sites fall within the shadow study area (Tier 2 required)

visualization.description: Interactive map showing buffer and intersected sites

properties.name: Example Tall Tower
properties.description: High-rise tower near Bryant Park, Midtown Manhattan — footprint aligned with Manhattan street grid (~29° from true north)

moduleData.description: CEQR Tier 2 directional screen. Eliminates sensitive resources in the triangular no-shadow zone south of the building (±108° from true north). Remaining sites proceed to Tier 3.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction for analysis. NYC uses CEQR ±108° threshold.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites GeoJSON. If omitted, uses default NYC Parks dataset.

moduleData.name: shadow_tier2_directional

no_shadow_zone.description: The triangular zone south of the building that can never receive shadow

sites_eliminated.description: Sensitive sites ruled out by Tier 2 directional screen

sites_requiring_tier3.description: Sensitive sites that could potentially receive shadow and require Tier 3 analysis

summary_report.description: Summary of Tier 2 directional screening results

triggered.description: True if any sensitive sites remain after Tier 2 screening (Tier 3 required)

visualization.description: Interactive map showing building, no-shadow zone, and site classifications

moduleData.description: CEQR Tier 3 screening: accurate 3D shadow projection using pysolar ephemeris and UTM geometry. Analyzes representative days within the 1.5h-after-sunrise to 1.5h-before-sunset window (EST, no DST). Determines if shadows reach sensitive resources.

analysis_dates.description: Dates for shadow analysis (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to CEQR representative days.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

building_height_ft.description: Building height in feet including all rooftop equipment

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction determines default analysis dates. NYC uses CEQR representative days.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites to check for shadow impacts. If omitted, uses default NYC Parks dataset.

moduleData.name: shadow_tier3_projection

shadow_polygons.description: Shadow polygon for each analysis time snapshot

sites_affected.description: Sensitive sites that receive shadow, with enter/exit times and duration per analysis day

visualization.description: Interactive map showing shadow sweeps for each analysis day with sensitive sites

moduleData.description: Builds a 3D LOD1 massing model of all surrounding buildings from NYC Building Footprints. Required prerequisite for CEQR incremental shadow analysis (Chapter 8, §320): establishes the No-Action context so the project's incremental shadow can be isolated.

building_geojson.description: Project building footprint — used to derive project location if project_location is omitted.

building_height_ft.description: Project height in feet. Used to auto-compute study area radius (4.3× height + 200 ft buffer) if study_area_radius_ft is omitted.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project centroid. Auto-derived from building_geojson if not provided.

project_site_bbls.description: List of BBLs to exclude (alternative to project_site_bins).

project_site_bins.description: List of BINs to exclude — buildings on the project site that will be demolished or replaced.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Radius from project site to load surrounding buildings (feet). Default: 4.3 × building_height_ft + 200 ft.

moduleData.name: shadow_context_builder

building_inventory.description: List of all buildings: BIN, height, height source, construction year.

context_geojson.description: 2D building footprints with height, BIN, and construction year for QA/visualization.

context_mesh_obj.description: OBJ file content: LOD1 flat-top extrusions of all surrounding buildings. Meters, Z-up, +Y=North, origin at project centroid. Feed into shadow-incremental as no_action_mesh_obj.

data_gap_report.description: Flags: buildings with missing height data, post-2014 buildings (no LOD2), freshness note.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project site — passed through for downstream modules.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Radius actually used (feet) — passed through for downstream modules.

visualization.description: Folium map: surrounding buildings colored by height, study area circle, project marker.

moduleData.description: Takes the project building footprint and the surrounding context mesh (from Shadow Context Builder) and assembles the No-Action and With-Action scenes for CEQR incremental shadow analysis. Also configures CEQR-compliant analysis dates and time windows.

analysis_dates.description: List of ISO date strings to analyze (e.g. ["2026-12-21", "2026-03-21"]). Defaults to CEQR NYC standard: Dec 21, Mar 21, May 6, Jun 21.

building_geojson.description: Project building footprint (GeoJSON). Used to extrude a box mesh when building_obj is not provided. Also used for location and visualization.

building_height_ft.description: Project building height in feet. Required when building_obj is not provided (used for box extrusion). Used as a label when building_obj is supplied.

building_obj.description: Pre-built OBJ of the project building (e.g. from an architect or Tier 3 OBJ module). If provided, skips box extrusion — use this for buildings with setbacks, tapered profiles, or complex massing. Must share the same local coordinate system as the context mesh (origin = project centroid, metres, Z-up, +Y=North).

context_mesh_obj.description: No-Action surrounding building massing (OBJ). Inherited from Shadow Context Builder. If omitted, With-Action scene contains only the project building.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project centroid. Inherited from Shadow Context Builder. Auto-derived from building_geojson if not provided.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Study area radius in feet — passed through from Shadow Context Builder.

moduleData.name: shadow_pipeline_builder

analysis_dates.description: Analysis date strings (CEQR standard or user-specified).

analysis_year.description: Calendar year used for solar calculations (current year).

building_height_ft.description: Project height in feet — passed through.

no_action_mesh_obj.description: No-Action scene OBJ (= context_mesh_obj passthrough). Feed into shadow-incremental.

project_mesh_obj.description: OBJ of project building alone. Origin at project centroid. Metres, Z-up, +Y=North. Feed into shadow-incremental as project_mesh_obj.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Study area radius in feet — passed through.

visualization.description: Folium map showing the project building footprint with height label.

with_action_mesh_obj.description: With-Action scene OBJ: context + project building combined. Feed into shadow-incremental.

moduleData.description: CEQR Chapter 8 incremental shadow analysis. Projects shadows from the No-Action and With-Action scenes (assembled by Shadow Pipeline Builder) and computes only the NEW shadow the project building casts — isolating the project's incremental contribution from existing shadows.

analysis_dates.description: ISO date strings to analyze. Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder (CEQR standard: Dec 21, Mar 21, May 6, Jun 21).

analysis_interval_min.description: Time interval between shadow snapshots (minutes). Default: 60 (CEQR standard).

analysis_year.description: Calendar year for solar calculations. Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

building_height_ft.description: Project height in feet — used for report narrative.

no_action_mesh_obj.description: No-Action scene OBJ (context buildings only). Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project site. Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites for impact assessment. Auto-inherited from Tier 2 (sites surviving directional screen) or Tier 1 (sites within buffer). Defaults to full NYC DPR parks dataset if not connected.

sites_affected.description: Tier 3 shadow impact schedule. Auto-inherited from Shadow Tier 3. When provided, the incremental calculation runs only at the timesteps where Tier 3 already detected shadow on a sensitive site — skipping the full CEQR time sweep entirely.

with_action_mesh_obj.description: With-Action scene OBJ (context + project building). Inherited from Shadow Pipeline Builder.

moduleData.name: shadow_incremental

affected_site_count.description: Total number of sensitive sites receiving incremental shadow.

affected_sites_geojson.description: GeoJSON of triggered sensitive sites (for mapping).

incremental_shadows_geojson.description: Shadow polygon per analysis timestep (for detailed mapping).

shadow_summary.description: Per-date summary: max incremental shadow area, affected site count, first/last shadow time.

summary_report.description: Formatted CEQR Chapter 8 incremental shadow analysis report.

triggered_sites.description: Primary result: sites that receive incremental shadow, keyed by site name. Each entry lists the analysis dates on which the site is affected, with shadow entry time, exit time, and duration (EST).

visualization.description: Interactive map: incremental shadow sweeps per date, triggered sites in orange, unaffected sites in purple.
